# Smart AI Bookkeeping

> Smart AI Bookkeeping runs the back office for trades businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, concrete, landscaping and other contractors): monthly books, job costing, billing, pay applications and WIP schedules, for a fixed monthly fee from $1,000/month. Founded by Tim O'Rourke in Lake Bluff, Illinois, serving the North Shore and Chicago suburbs in person and clients anywhere remotely.

## Facts

- Business name: Smart AI Bookkeeping
- Founder: Tim O'Rourke
- Location: Lake Bluff, IL (North Shore / Chicago suburbs); also works with clients remotely
- Service: the monthly back office for trades businesses, with Claude AI doing the repetitive entry and matching and an accountant reviewing the numbers
- Who it's for: service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical service, landscaping, pest control) and project trades (concrete, roofing, framing, electrical and mechanical subs, general contractors)
- Price:
  - Books $1,000/month: monthly books, bank and card reconciliations, job profit report
  - Back Office $2,000/month: Books plus bill pay, invoicing and collections, payroll entries, and for project trades pay applications, retainage and WIP schedules
  - Controller $4,000/month: Back Office plus cash forecast, over/under billing review, statements ready for bank and bonding
  - One-time start fee from $2,500 (cleanup, setup and automation; more if months behind)
  - Price rises above about 15 open jobs, about 25 people on payroll, more than one company, or certified payroll
  - Founding offer: first three trades clients get $500/month off for three months in exchange for a case study; 90-day out
- Accounting software: QuickBooks (10+ years)
- Background: ran his own accounting firm, Order Up Profits, for 10 years (clients included construction companies); full construction job costing experience (WIP schedules, progress billing, retainage, lien waivers); Senior Accountant at Martin Brower (McDonald's global distributor), booking $500M+/month in cash transactions, leading unclaimed property audit prep that recovered $100k+, and building Alteryx automations; MS in Accounting, DePaul University
- Tim O'Rourke is not a CPA.
- Book a free 20-minute call: https://calendly.com/timorourke/new-meeting-1
- Email: torourke358@hotmail.com
